description: Pull a member into a thread. Adding someone to a private thread they cannot see now lets them read all of it, earlier messages included, so that needs confirming: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirm_token, and repeating the call with the token adds them.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

name: add_thread_member
title: Add thread member
